EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All the conditions mentioned in the tender Notification document

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Maintenance of Existing Elephant Proof Trench At Heggudilu Jameenu in Saraguru Range During 2026-27

itemList.description: Maintenance fo EPT for the specification mentoned in SSR item NO.96(a) Including dressing of edges of EPT and reforming of the mound on the inner side of EPT with the excavated soil (Excavation of elephant proof trenches of size 3.00 Mtr top width, 1.5Mtr Depth & 1.5 Mtr bottom width with an intial lead up to 3Mtr & Depositing the excavated soil uniformly over the inner side of the elephant proof trench & forming conical mound of height 1.5 M including compacting the mound) (FOR SSR NO:97 Machinary work)
